description: Fetch up to 10 distinct observations by id with their community identification thread — who identified what, whether each identification agrees, and the consensus taxon the community landed on. The whole attempted batch costs one upstream request. Records come back in requested order; remaining distinct ids are deferred for another call with the same include. Missing attempted ids appear in unresolved; the call fails only when nothing resolved and no deferred work remains. Identifications, comments, and observation fields are sorted by ascending id (creation order) and share the array_limit budget across resolved records — by default up to 40 entries per array for one record, 4 for a full batch; every record reports the size of each array beside what it kept, and next_array_offset pages the rest.

array_limit.description: Entry budget per capped array, shared across the records returned: each record keeps min(array_limit, max(4, floor(array_limit ÷ records))) entries of each. One call can take a whole thread of one record. Ceiling: 1500; oversized values are clamped.

array_offset.description: Absolute index into every capped array (identifications, comments, observation_fields), each sorted by ascending id: 0 starts at the earliest entry. Pass the previous reply’s next_array_offset to continue; new entries append, so offsets stay valid as a thread grows. For the newest identifications, include only identifications and set this to identifications_total minus array_limit. Past the end returns empty arrays with their totals.

include.description: Embedded arrays to expand per record. identifications is the default and is what carries the thread; the others cost context, so check photo_count and sound_count first. identifications and comments — like the observation_fields every record carries — are sorted by ascending id and share the array_limit budget (default 40) across the batch: each record keeps min(array_limit, max(4, floor(array_limit ÷ records returned))) entries per array from array_offset, and reports identifications_total, comments_total, and observation_fields_total beside what it kept.

observation_id.description: Observation ids to fetch, 1 to 100 submitted ids. The first 10 distinct ids are attempted; any remaining distinct ids are deferred to another call. Find current ids for an area with inaturalist_search_observations.

name: inaturalist_get_observation

array_offset.description: The array_offset this page of every capped array starts at.

deferred.description: Distinct ids beyond the attempted batch, in requested order. Empty when no work remains.

items.description: One id to request in a subsequent call.

observation_id.description: An id not attempted in this call.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: None of the attempted ids resolved to an observation and no deferred ids remain. `rate_budget_exhausted`: This server has spent its daily iNaturalist request budget for the current UTC day. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

next_array_offset.description: Pass as array_offset with the same observation_id and include to continue every capped array of every record. Null when no array holds entries past this page.

notice.description: Guidance when part of the batch did not resolve, when array_limit was clamped, or when a thread or observation-field list continues past this page.

observations.description: The observations that resolved, in the requested order with unresolved ids left out, carrying the expansions that were requested.

agreements.description: How many identifications currently agree with the community taxon.

annotations.description: Decoded annotations. Present when "annotations" was included.

items.description: One decoded annotation on the record.

attribute.description: Attribute label, e.g. "Life Stage"; null for an unknown id.

attribute_id.description: Attribute id, usable as term_id on the search tools.

by.description: Login of the member who added the annotation.

value.description: Value label, e.g. "Larva"; null for an unknown id.

value_id.description: Value id, usable as term_value_id on the search tools.

captive.description: True for a zoo animal, a garden planting, or other cultivation.

comments.description: Requested comments sorted by ascending id, which is posting order, paged like identifications.

items.description: One discussion comment on the record.

created_at.description: When the comment was posted, ISO 8601.

hidden.description: True when a moderator hid this comment; it keeps its place in the list. Absent when upstream sent no flag.

comments_hidden.description: Hidden comments among all comments, the same on every page; present with "comments". Hidden entries are kept and counted in comments_total.

comments_shown.description: Comment entries on this page; below comments_total when the page holds part of them.

comments_total.description: Whole comment count, the same on every page; present with "comments".

common_name.description: Preferred common name, when one is recorded.

iconic_taxon_name.description: Broad organism group, e.g. "Insecta". Usable as an iconic_taxa filter value.

id.description: Taxon id — the identifier every taxon-scoped filter takes.

community_taxon.description: Resolved consensus taxon on detail records; null without consensus.

community_taxon_id.description: Consensus taxon id. Differs from taxon.id while a thread is contested.

accuracy_m.description: Public accuracy radius, metres. An obscured point is a locality, not a sighting position.

coordinate.description: Public coordinate. Null when the record carries none.

created_at.description: Record creation timestamp, verbatim from upstream. Null when absent.

description.description: Verbatim observer note on detail records; null when none was written, distinct from an empty string.

disagreements.description: How many identifications currently disagree with the community taxon.

geoprivacy.description: Observer-set coordinate privacy: obscured, obscured_private, open, or private.

id.description: Observation id. Also the cursor value for deep pagination.

identification_disagreements_count.description: Upstream disagreement count on detail records.

identifications.description: Requested identification thread sorted by ascending id, which is creation order: the page from array_offset, at most each record’s share of array_limit. The resource keeps the first 40.

items.description: One identification in the community thread.

body.description: Free-text note written by the identifier.

category.description: How this identification moved the thread: improving, supporting, leading, or maverick.

created_at.description: When the identification was added, ISO 8601.

current.description: True when this is the identifier’s current identification on the record.

disagreement.description: True when the identifier explicitly disagreed with the preceding taxon.

from_vision.description: True when the identification came from the upstream image classifier.

hidden.description: True when a moderator hid this identification; it keeps its place in the thread. Absent when upstream sent no flag.

common_name.description: Preferred common name, when one is recorded.

iconic_taxon_name.description: Broad organism group, e.g. "Insecta". Usable as an iconic_taxa filter value.

id.description: Taxon id — the identifier every taxon-scoped filter takes.

identifications_count.description: Tally against the community taxon: agreements + disagreements. Excludes the observer and neutral/withdrawn ids; thread size is identifications_total on inaturalist_get_observation.

identifications_hidden.description: Hidden identifications in the whole thread, the same on every page; present with "identifications". Hidden entries are kept and counted in identifications_total.

identifications_shown.description: Identification entries on this page; below identifications_total when the page holds part of the thread.

identifications_total.description: Whole thread size, the same on every page; present with "identifications".

license_code.description: Licence of the observation record itself. Null means all rights reserved.

obscured.description: True when the true coordinate is withheld; the public point is a locality.

observation_fields.description: Filled fields on detail records, verbatim; blanks omitted, then sorted by ascending field-value id and paged like identifications.

datatype.description: Field type as upstream names it, e.g. text, numeric, taxon, date. Null when upstream sent none.

taxon.description: The taxon a taxon-type value names, when upstream resolved one; its id works with inaturalist_get_taxon and taxon_id filters. Absent for free text, such as a typed species name.

common_name.description: Preferred common name, when one is recorded.

iconic_taxon_name.description: Broad organism group, e.g. "Insecta". Usable as an iconic_taxa filter value.

id.description: Taxon id — the identifier every taxon-scoped filter takes.

value.description: The value filled in, verbatim. On a taxon field it is usually a taxon id.

observation_fields_shown.description: Filled fields on this page; below observation_fields_total when the page holds part of them.

observation_fields_total.description: Whole filled field count on detail records, the same on every page.

observed_on.description: Observation date, YYYY-MM-DD. Null when the observer recorded no date.

outlinks.description: External copies of the record in upstream order, e.g. its GBIF occurrence for citation; empty when none. GBIF links appear only on research-grade CC0, CC BY, or CC BY-NC records once exported.

items.description: One external database holding a copy of this record.

source.description: External database name, verbatim, e.g. "GBIF". Null when upstream sent none.

url.description: The record’s page in that database, verbatim. Null when upstream sent none.

anyOf.description: A photo with the attribution and licence that must travel with it.

attribution.description: Verbatim attribution; reproduce with any use of the image.

license_code.description: Photo licence code. Null means all rights reserved, independent of the record.

medium_url.description: Medium image URL; derived from the size path if needed. Absent when no variant is available.

open.description: True when served from the open-licence host at fetch time; licences can change.

square_url.description: 75px square variant, exactly as upstream published it. Null when absent.

photo.description: First photo on the record. Null when there are none.

photo_count.description: Photo count; include "photos" for every photo.

photos.description: Every photo on the record. Present when "photos" was included.

items.description: A photo with the attribution and licence that must travel with it.

attribution.description: Verbatim attribution; reproduce with any use of the image.

license_code.description: Photo licence code. Null means all rights reserved, independent of the record.

medium_url.description: Medium image URL; derived from the size path if needed. Absent when no variant is available.

open.description: True when served from the open-licence host at fetch time; licences can change.

square_url.description: 75px square variant, exactly as upstream published it. Null when absent.

place_guess.description: Locality text written by the observer. Third-party free text.

quality_grade.description: Identification confidence tier: research, needs_id, or casual.

sound_count.description: How many audio recordings the record carries.

sounds.description: Audio recordings. Present when "sounds" was included.

items.description: An audio recording with its attribution and licence.

license_code.description: Sound licence code. Null means all rights reserved.

url.description: Audio file URL. Null when upstream published none.

common_name.description: Preferred common name, when one is recorded.

iconic_taxon_name.description: Broad organism group, e.g. "Insecta". Usable as an iconic_taxa filter value.

id.description: Taxon id — the identifier every taxon-scoped filter takes.

taxon.description: Current identification. Null when nobody has identified the record.

taxon_geoprivacy.description: Coordinate privacy applied automatically for a threatened taxon. Same vocabulary.

updated_at.description: Record update timestamp, verbatim from upstream. Null when absent.

url.description: Canonical iNaturalist page for the record.

uuid.description: Stable UUID, independent of the id sequence.

items.description: One id that did not resolve.

observation_id.description: A requested id upstream returned no record for.
